claimUnderReview: Heartbeat refresh deduplication is durably implemented as source and regression source without claiming existing-overlay runtime wiring or phone delivery.

materialChecks.detail: Separate render and announcement identities prevent a fast poll from automatically becoming a fast subtree rebuild or TalkBack loop.
Visible evidence/provenance detail may change render identity without changing announcement identity.
Persisted storage/parser rejection composes the existing last-good scene and keeps discarded attempted state out of the model.
Selection is retained by semantic light id and cleared if that id disappears, never silently transferred by focus index.

Initial source version treated empty prior announcement identity as a transition. Code-first review changed the contract so cold start may render but cannot claim it witnessed a transition or auto-announce stale persisted state.
No service, renderer, state store, receiver, transport, queue, phone executor, or P0 coordinator was created.

deterministicTestGate.annotation: The job was not started because an Actions budget is preventing further use.
